author: ReTrace
description: Streaming parser for Sysinternals Procmon XML exports.

tools.name: procmon_behavior_summary
tools.capability: Summarize behavior from loaded Procmon events: process start, loaded images, files, registry.

tools.name: procmon_dll_hijack_candidates
tools.capability: Find DLL search-order hijacking candidates from the runtime trace (CWE-427).

tools.name: procmon_export_graph_events
tools.capability: Return a compact graph-ready projection of the loaded Procmon summary.

tools.name: procmon_insecure_file_usage
tools.capability: Find file operations in user-writable locations (CWE-732, CWE-427, CWE-377).

tools.name: procmon_load_artifact
tools.capability: Alias for procmon_load_xml used by artifact routers that pass a resolved workspace path.

tools.name: procmon_load_xml
tools.capability: Load a Procmon XML export and build an in-memory searchable event index.

tools.name: procmon_query_events
tools.capability: Query loaded Procmon events by operation/path/result/detail/process.

tools.name: procmon_summary
tools.capability: Return summary of the currently loaded Procmon XML.

tools.name: procmon_va_summary
tools.capability: Run all the vulnerability-assessment views over the loaded trace in one call: DLL hijack
